K2-18 b transmission spectrum

JWST MIRI low-resolution spectroscopy · 25–26 April 2024 UTC · Program 2722

Each point shows the fraction of starlight blocked during transit in one wavelength bin. Vertical bars show the published uncertainty. Horizontal bars span the bin. Select a point or use the list to inspect its values.

Download all 29 bins with citations (CSV). The CSV preserves the original fractional depths. Multiply by one million to reproduce the plot in parts per million.

Why interpretations differ

Madhusudhan and colleagues compared atmospheric models with the spectrum and reported a possible contribution from dimethyl sulfide or dimethyl disulfide. The chart shows their JExoRES reduction. Identifying molecules requires comparing models across bins. Original analysis · Published measurements

Luque and colleagues combined these mid-infrared observations with shorter-wavelength spectra and found insufficient evidence for either molecule. Their result illustrates how wavelength coverage and data reduction affect the interpretation. Independent analysis · Archived observations
